A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ActivationReasoning study and contain readable text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–K. Pages 2–24 have identical text and rendered content; differences are confined to first-page author information and the arXiv stamp.

before.justification: v2 reports original AR evaluations on PrOntoQA, Rail2Country, ProverQA, and BeaverTails, alongside runtime measurements, additional comparisons, and ablations in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results in Tables 1–6 and the layer-placement experiment in Appendix G.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains identical concept extraction, single/multi/relational feature representations, activation thresholding, forward chaining, and decoder-based steering procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use PrOntoQA at 1/3/5 hops, Rail2Country Mono/Meta, ProverQA at three difficulty levels, and BeaverTails across 14 safety categories. No datasets, tasks, or test scenarios change.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged across the corresponding tables, including larger instruction-tuned models, GPT-4o, DeepSeek-R1-8B, Base SAE, and the instruction, CoT, majority-vote, and self-consistency variants in Table 4.

E3.justification: Section 4 and the experimental appendices retain identical models, SAE placements, splits, sample counts, metrics, hyperparameters, and decoding procedures, including four-sample majority voting and self-consistency.

E4.justification: Appendices F–H retain the same per-simile and per-country analyses, SAE-placement ablation, and sensitivity experiments for representation size, incoming features, steering strength, and thresholding.

E5.justification: No seed, repeated-run, or uncertainty-reporting information is added or revised. Both retain the same point-estimate reporting without confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–6, the layer-ablation accuracies in Appendix G, and the reported qualitative findings are identical. No results are added, removed, or corrected.

T1.justification: The formal concept definitions, equations, and propositional reasoning semantics in Section 3 and Appendix D are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list, and conclusion retain identical claims about the AR framework, Rail2Country benchmark, structured reasoning, transparency, robustness, and control.

C2.justification: The interpretations and limitations remain identical, including dependence on SAE feature quality, manually or semi-automatically specified rules, and unexplored open-ended and long-context reasoning settings.

D1.justification: The implementation settings, hardware specifications, runtime information, and code/data access statements are unchanged, including Appendices A–C, H, and J.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the reference list are identical. Positioning relative to concept interpretability, neuro-symbolic reasoning, and safety or steering research does not change.

P1.justification: v3 adds a dagger after Felix Friedrich, linking him to the existing work-location footnote, and adjusts author-line spacing. The arXiv stamp changes from v2 dated 9 February 2026 to v3 dated 11 May 2026. The manuscript prose and section structure are otherwise unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–2 and Tables 1–6 retain identical captions, formatting, and placement. Page organization is unchanged, and pages 2–24 render identically; the first-page author and version edits do not reorganize the layout.

improvement.justification: v3 makes a limited author-footnote clarification and updates version metadata. The scientific content, empirical evidence, technical documentation, and presentation of the main text and appendices remain unchanged, establishing no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
